supersedes_only: Exploratory execution gate and return precision policy of rounds 1/2; original checkpoints preserved
authorized_reorientation: User explicitly accepts economically close return approximations; preserve material events, PIT, historical denominator, validation split and publication limits
formation_and_universe: Reuse accepted company/date representatives; never select security or include/exclude company by outcome

grades.A: Previously reconciled economic path, including 24 round2 certificates; documentary corrections may extend coverage without claiming complete cents-level reconciliation
grades.B: Raw-price/event shareholder path, bounded endpoint staleness, known material structural events handled, no uncorroborated mechanical adjustment or material unresolved event; sampling checks by cohort, sector and economic state
grades.C: Material lineage/event/identity/gap uncertainty; retain full denominator and explicit causes; never zero or last-price-fill as observed return

prices.adj_close: Comparator only unless independently validated; no use in market cap
prices.detected_splits: Price-only DETECTED factors cannot turn actual crashes into artificial flat returns; require documentary or other independent corroboration

materiality.threshold_rule: Preserve ambiguity if sensitivity range crosses wealth 0.5/3 or market benchmark; report lower/upper frequencies, never convenient classification

exploration_sufficiency.economic_state_rule: Publish A/B/C coverage of historical BDI distress, exits and materially unresolved events; no broad reliable claim if worst-case missing-loss bounds reverse effect or problematic coverage gap exceeds 20 percentage points
exploration_sufficiency.insufficient_strata: Publish computed conditional exploratory effects and conservative bounds, explicitly withholding general predictive claims; do not use gate as a reason to skip all empirical computation

indicator_conditions.financial: Banks/insurers separately; no industrial EBIT margin, cash conversion, current ratio, ROIC, EV/EBITDA or leverage screening for financial firms
indicator_conditions.valuation: Raw contemporaneous class prices, documented shares public before formation, treasury/class/unit compatibility; otherwise missing with explicit cause
indicator_conditions.ebitda: Do not relabel parser EBIT as EBITDA
indicator_conditions.growth: Exact reference/version/receipt known at formation, no later comparative-period values

univariate: Spearman within formation cohort plus equal-cohort pooled ranks; quintiles formed within cohort, deterministic ties, aggregate lower/upper threshold frequencies

oos.rule: Freeze all directions/thresholds/combinations before inspecting feature/outcome relations; one 5y evaluation cohort is not temporal validation

inference.time_condition: Fewer than four independent horizon-sized calendar blocks prohibits time-general confirmatory p-values. Cluster-company intervals are conditional on observed calendar; horizon-block sensitivity also reported
inference.multiplicity: BH and dependence-robust BY across entire declared indicator/horizon nominal/relative family where valid resampling p-values exist; never daily IC iid t-test
inference.no_pvalue_shortcut: Economic magnitude, persistence, OOS and missing-loss robustness required; no isolated p-value promise

sensitivity: A only descriptive, no representative claim
missing-C binary worst-case bounds across full model-eligible universe
C all-zero recovery scenario explicitly hypothetical, not observed returns
publication: Only own aggregated statistics, code, synthetic tests, provenance and documentation; individual B3 trajectories and source files remain local; PR draft without merge
